bounded_diagnosis.finding: Cyclic Latin rotations balanced candidate positions but preserved a fixed immediate predecessor for every candidate.
bounded_diagnosis.example: For flow-n50000-w128-m1000-s3303, raw_materialized_aggregate preceded postjoin_mask_fused_sorted_output in every non-first round; the latter ranged from about 89 ms to 307 ms.
bounded_diagnosis.scientific_consequence: Candidate carryover cannot be separated from candidate cost, so this run cannot authorize optimizer performance claims or weight changes.
bounded_diagnosis.corrective_action: Keep the optimizer unchanged and rerun with a Williams design that balances both positions and direct predecessors.
